text: いいニュースと　いうものは　いろんなひとに　よまれてこそ　ほんとうの　かちが　でるものじゃ！

structure.jp: いいニュースと　いうものは
いろんなひとに　よまれてこそ
structure.en: only when it is read by all sorts of people

structure.jp: ほんとうの　かちが　でるものじゃ！
structure.en: does its true value come out!

patterns.name: 〜てこそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a て-form verb means 'only when this happens'. よまれてこそ = 'only when it gets read'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending says the thing is done to it by someone, and に shows who does it. いろんなひとに　よまれて = 'being read by all sorts of people'.

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.explanation: ものだ at the end says 'that is how things naturally are'. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. かちが　でるものじゃ = 'that is when its value comes out'.
